scope: Host-side disposable UTM VM only; production moltMacOS VM and its disk were never started, stopped, guarded, cloned or modified by this rehearsal

rehearsal.before_guard: disposable VM started from its own ASIF disk and stopped; no source-image holder or attachment was reported
rehearsal.guard: owner set UF_IMMUTABLE on the stopped disposable image; stat flags were 2 on the same device and inode
rehearsal.guarded_start: utmctl start printed 'Configuration de machine virtuelle non valide. La connexion du périphérique de stockage n’est pas valide.'; after two seconds utmctl status remained stopped and the immutable flag remained set
rehearsal.unlock: owner cleared UF_IMMUTABLE on the same image inode; stat flags returned to 0
rehearsal.post_unlock_start: utmctl status reported started after three seconds; the same disposable VM then stopped normally

conclusion: B2's disposable-VM start-denial and post-unlock recovery mechanism passed. A production boot controller must check resulting VM status and error; utmctl's zero process exit on a refused start is not success. This does not prove a production full-node hold, continuous boot exclusion, clean shutdown, four-history capture or operational resumption.
